responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for FT32 target-specific command-line options declared in ft32.opt. This file does not define option semantics itself; instead it associates each option name with the corresponding anchor in the generated GCC manual (for FT32-Options.html), so GCC’s option metadata and diagnostics/help infrastructure can reference the right online/manual documentation entry for switches such as -msim, -mlra, -mnodiv, -mft32b, -mcompress, and -mnopm.
